description:
Create a custom voice from a text description. Free; the voice lives 365 days.

request: display_name, prompt (10-1000 characters: age, timbre, pace, manner, accent), gender
(male, female or neutral) and optional language_code (default ru-RU). The result holds the voice
(use its id as custom_voice_id in create_speech) and a short sample. An account keeps at most 5 saved
voices (made here or in the studio; expired ones do not count): the sixth fails with 409
VOICE_LIMIT_REACHED, details.limit and details.used, and delete_speech_voice makes room. Google also caps
the whole project at 200 voices (the same 409). One creation per account at a time: a parallel one fails
with 429 VOICE_CREATION_IN_PROGRESS, wait and retry. There is no idempotency key: after a timeout check
list_my_speech_voices before retrying, and remove an extra voice with delete_speech_voice.

display_name.description: Name shown in your voice list.
display_name.title: Display Name

language_code.description: BCP-47 language code of the voice, for example ru-RU or en-US.
language_code.title: Language Code

prompt.description: Describe the voice: age, timbre, pace, manner, accent.
prompt.title: Prompt

name: design_speech_voice
